description.ja: • 人革連の量産型MS“ティエレン地上型”がメカニカルディテールを訴求した1/100スケールモデルで登場
description.en: • Human Resource Federation's mass-produced MS "Tieren ground type" is now available as a 1/100 Scale Model that emphasizes mechanical details.

description.ja: • 機体表面はシボ加工で戦車の装甲のような質感を再現
description.en: • The surface of the aircraft is textured to reproduce the texture of tank armor.

description.ja: • 実在の兵器を彷彿とさせるディテールを随所に取り込み、リアルな機械感を表現
description.en: • Incorporates details reminiscent of real weapons throughout to create a realistic mechanical feel.

description.ja: • 速射砲とカーボンブレードに加え、新デザインのバズーカが付属
description.en: • In addition to the rapid-fire cannon and carbon blade, a newly designed bazooka is included.

description.ja: • 機体と同スケールのパイロットフィギュア×1と歩兵フィギュア×2が付属
description.en: • Includes 1 pilot figure and 2 infantry figures of the same scale as the aircraft.
